stories.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
stories.explanation: OpenAI is acquiring Pierre Computer Company, Inc., known for Code Storage and open-source developer tools, to expand Codex's capabilities for building, understanding, and reviewing code.

stories.title: Google Is Forcing AI Overviews in Classrooms. Schools Are Searching for a Way Out
stories.explanation: Google is declining to provide schools an option to disable AI Overviews, tying them to traditional search. This decision has angered parents and educators who worry about students' critical thinking skills.

stories.title: AI Is Changing How Semiconductor Fabs Work — and Engineers Are Moving Faster Because of It
stories.explanation: NVIDIA announced that AI is transforming semiconductor manufacturing, with accelerated simulation, learned physics models, and AI agents helping engineers move faster in design, testing, and manufacturing.

stories.title: NVIDIA CUDA 13.5 Brings NVIDIA Vera Rubin GA Support
stories.explanation: NVIDIA released CUDA 13.5, which includes general availability for NVIDIA Vera Rubin support and extends Windows on Arm support to NVIDIA DGX Station, enhancing performance and scale for AI and accelerated computing.

stories.title: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
stories.explanation: OpenAI's Daybreak Red, featuring GPT-5.6 Cyber, is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock, providing government security teams with advanced cybersecurity models for authorized work.

stories.title: Gemini for Home now plugs into AT&T’s smart security system
stories.explanation: AT&T's Connected Life System now integrates with Google's Gemini for Home, enabling AI features like home event summaries and video history search. This makes AT&T the first home security product to integrate with Google Home Premium.

stories.title: I tried Apple’s Siri Recaps. They’re surprisingly useful — and a little unsettling
stories.explanation: Apple rolled out AI-powered Siri Recaps into testing for iOS 27.3 and watchOS 27.3, offering features like conversation summaries and note-taking. The author found them useful despite initial privacy reservations.

stories.title: Dharma Field Extractor: Any Document In, Structured Fields in JSON Out
stories.explanation: Dharma-AI released Dharma Field Extractor on Hugging Face, a 2-billion-parameter model that extracts structured fields from any document type into JSON, outperforming frontier LLMs at a lower cost.

stories.title: Ukraine’s drone strikes spur hasty Russian plans for underground data centers
stories.explanation: Russian tech companies are planning to harden and hide data centers underground after Ukrainian drone strikes damaged facilities housing AI supercomputers. This development shows the impact of geopolitical conflict on AI infrastructure.

stories.title: Open source AI is booming. Hugging Face explains who profits.
stories.explanation: Hugging Face's Irene Solaiman discussed how startups can build on open AI models, evaluate tools, and secure the open ecosystem. This addresses the growing mainstream adoption of open-source AI and the challenges of value capture.
